visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation sequence featuring a simple white dog-like character wearing a navy cap against a black background. Bright yellow and red text highlights the theme of visiting Mazu for the first time. The character exhibits subtle expressions, moving its eyes and head while narrative text scrolls above it. (2) Real-life video segments showing crowds of people in Taiwan. Many individuals wear high-visibility yellow or pink vests and orange hats, walking along narrow city streets. A decorated religious palanquin with a pink canopy is visible, being carried by a group of dedicated pilgrims through the traffic. (3) Return to animation where the dog character sits at a desk with a computer monitor. It later appears distressed, with dark circles under its eyes and swirling scribble lines over its head, symbolizing mental fatigue. The background is mostly white with large, simplified furniture elements. (4) The dog character is shown in a high-energy animated sequence with large, expressive eyes and a wide-open mouth. Stylized yellow and orange fire effects roar behind it, suggesting a burst of determination and passion. The animation style is clean and uses thick black outlines. (5) A digital map interface is shown, indicating a specific street intersection in Yunlin. A red arrow points to a location labeled as a rest area for the Mazu pilgrimage. The scene transitions to a close-up of a mobile phone screen displaying a train ticket reservation. (6) Real-life footage of a train station at dawn. The camera moves in a handheld fashion, showing a man in his late 20s wearing a blue cap and gray jacket walking past station signs. He holds a phone and records himself in a selfie perspective. (7) Shot of a green rural landscape taken from a moving train window. The view shows grassy fields, low-rise residential buildings, and a pale blue sky with scattered clouds. The camera motion is steady but slightly vibrating from the train's movement. (8) Animation of the dog character at 'Linnei' station, showing surprise. This is followed by real-life clips of a massive crowd of pilgrims gathered at the station exit. People are holding up smartphones to film the arrival of the sacred palanquin. (9) Detailed real-life footage of the religious palanquin, decorated with colorful tassels and a pink silk roof, passing closely through a dense crowd. Police officers and volunteers in uniforms manage the flow of people. The lighting is natural overcast daylight. (10) A final montage showing the creator walking among thousands of pilgrims on a wide suburban road. The background features green hills and power lines. The creator smiles at the camera, looking sweaty but satisfied, as the crowd moves forward together.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 第一次去媽祖進香. [Variety]: 就發生不敢相信的事. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近一年一度的白沙屯媽祖進香開始了. (3) [Subtitle]: 我每天的YouTube影片都可以刷到各種新聞鋪天蓋地而來呀. (4) [Subtitle]: 說老實話, 最近真的狀況不太好. (5) [Subtitle]: 不知道是鬼故事講太多了還是心情沒有出口能夠調適. (6) [Subtitle]: 即使看了諮商以及身心科還是沒有一個能夠讓心情釋放的答案. (7) [Subtitle]: 於是我決定了科學的盡頭就是玄學. (8) [Subtitle]: 走一趟白沙屯媽祖試看看那現場的魅力吧. (9) [Subtitle]: 因為是臨時決定的, 我禮拜一查白沙屯媽祖晚上在雲林休息. (10) [Subtitle]: 隔天早上就會6點出發繼續往北走. (11) [Subtitle]: 而我沒有交通工具, 沒有開車. (12) [Subtitle]: 隔天一早能夠最快從台南出發的火車也是自強號的6點半時間. (13) [Subtitle]: 並且還需要轉車, 預計抵達媽祖雲林休息區時也是早上8點了. (14) [Subtitle]: 早上媽祖6點就出發, 而我8點才能到. (15) [Subtitle]: 差了兩個小時的路程, 我能不能夠補回來呢. (16) [Subtitle]: 不管了先去再說吧. (17) [Subtitle]: 禮拜二一早我就換裝出門. (18) [Subtitle]: 火車抵達斗六之後開始等下一班的轉車火車要到石榴站. (19) [Subtitle]: 原本一個人來人生地不熟的我我很擔心呢. (20) [Subtitle]: 但是過了10分鐘後我突然一陣安心了. (21) [Subtitle]: 一群看起來很資深的玩家包圍了我頓時一陣心安吶. (22) [Subtitle]: 感覺跟這群老手走准沒錯. (23) [Subtitle]: 而沒過多久一起搭上了火車到了原本預計下車的石榴站到了. (24) [Subtitle]: 結果沒有半個人要下車. (25) [Subtitle]: 我秉持著大家不動我也不動, 繼續搭火車往下一站走林內站. (26) [Subtitle]: 沒想到林內站一停全部分人都衝下車. (27) [Subtitle]: 而我一下車之後隨著人群到了票口不可置信的事情發生了. (28) [Subtitle]: 白沙屯媽祖的神轎就停在林內站火車站門口啊. (29) [Subtitle]: 這是我第一次追進香, 沒想到首刷SSR. (30) [Subtitle]: 當我在車站裡面媽祖的鑾轎就離我這麼近了. (31) [Subtitle]: 當我走出火車站之後也被引導到神轎前可以雙手合十拜拜. (32) [Subtitle]: 但真的太突然了我也不知道說什麼. (33) [Subtitle]: 只好腦袋當機行禮拜拜之後就隨著工作人員引導往後面走. (34) [Subtitle]: 這時的我還很衝擊, 畢竟哪有人一下車就遇到媽祖. (35) [Subtitle]: 而且還沒有反應過來旁邊的人居然就以3個人為一排開始排隊跪下了. (36) [Subtitle]: 看到這一幕的我我不禁地想. (37) [Subtitle]: 難道該不會真的是傳說中的「躦轎腳」吧. (38) [Subtitle]: 就這樣我也跟著人群一起跪在那裡等著媽祖的神轎經過. (39) [Subtitle]: 第一次追媽祖的我在下火車20分鐘內完成了拜拜+躦轎腳的雙重任務解鎖. (40) [Subtitle]: 我根本就是玩遊戲就開局首刷SSR的人吶. (41) [Subtitle]: 而最後雖然任務都解鎖了我還是跟著隊伍走了一段好長的路. (42) [Subtitle]: 直到媽祖走進了南投之後我才結束這一段旅程. (43) [Subtitle]: 如果你要問我這一趟的旅程有沒有什麼特別的改善或是讓我變得更好. (44) [Subtitle]: 我不知道但是在這一路上的巧遇不管是能夠在車站遇到媽祖來接我. (45) [Subtitle]: 或是能夠跟一群陌生人走在路上一起享受那種氣氛流汗熱情. (46) [Variety]: SSR. [Logo]: @baishatun_tv. [Slogan]: 鑽轎腳.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear, male narrative voice in Mandarin, delivered at a moderate conversational pace. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic-pop track with a consistent drum beat and bright synth melodies. A subtle UI click sound effect marks text transitions. (2) The narrator's tone shifts to a more personal and slightly lower pitch while discussing mental health. The BGM continues but slightly ducks in volume to allow the vocal clarity to remain high. Occasional soft 'whoosh' sound effects transition between the animated segments and narration phases. (3) A sharp, high-pitched 'ding' sound effect triggers as the narrator makes a decision. The music intensity rises slightly with a more driving rhythm. The acoustic environment is very clean, indicating a studio-recorded voiceover with high spectral brightness and no environmental noise. (4) As the video transitions to real-life footage, a layer of ambient outdoor noise is introduced, including the faint sound of wind, distant traffic, and the rumble of a moving train. These sounds are mixed lower than the primary narration and BGM. (5) The narrator's vocal arousal increases significantly as he describes the 'SSR' (lucky) encounter. Multiple celebratory SFX like sparkles and light impacts are audible. In the real-life segments, the sound of a large crowd chatting and cheering becomes clearly present. (6) During the pilgrimage scenes, the rhythmic chanting of the crowd and the sound of footsteps on pavement are audible. The narrator's voice maintains a high dominance and positive valence. A cartoon-style 'boing' SFX is used during a comedic realization moment. (7) The video concludes with the BGM swelling into a full, energetic mix with strong bass and percussive elements. The narrator's voice returns to a reflective, warm tone. The sound of thousands of people moving together creates a dense, broadband environmental floor before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Journey -> Surprise Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To narrate a personal and spiritually uplifting story about participating in the Baishatun Mazu pilgrimage for the first time. The video emphasizes a lucky encounter (likened to an 'SSR' pull in a game) where the creator managed to participate in key religious rituals shortly after arriving, providing a sense of healing and community connection.
